extension.summary: Stream media from The Basement MediaHub
extension.description: The Basement MediaHub Kodi Add-on allows you to browse and stream media content from your centralized MediaHub server directly within Kodi. Supports video, audio, and image content from the shared media-api.
extension.disclaimer: For personal use only. Requires a running instance of The Basement MediaHub media-api.
extension.news: v1.0.0 - Initial release. Browse and stream media from The Basement MediaHub.
